name: commands

commands.description: The friendly name of the command.

fileName.description: The name of the executable file name. Example: "cmd.exe".

workingDirectory.description: Specify a relative or absolute directory path.

arguments.description: The arguments to pass to the executable file.

vsbindings.description: A Visual Studio event that a command can be bound to.

-vs-binding.description: Specify any Visual Studio event bindings.

description:
Hi team,

I've set up the command configuration for our .NET solution. The **buildProject** command invokes the `dotnet` executable from the `./src/MyApp` directory, using the arguments `build -c Release` to produce a Release build. For testing, the **runTests** command also calls `dotnet` but simply runs `test ./tests/MyApp.Tests.csproj` to execute the test suite.

In Visual Studio, I've bound these actions to the appropriate build events: after a successful build the `BuildEvents.AfterBuild` handler will fire, before a build starts `BuildEvents.BeforeBuild` runs, the clean operation triggers `BuildEvents.Clean`, and when the solution is opened the `SolutionEvents.Opened` event is hooked. Let me know if any adjustments are needed.
